---
title: "Cleaning"
format: pdf
---

Loading in the .txt file

```{r}
# Read the text file
albums_raw <- readLines("Albums.txt")

# Remove blank lines
albums_raw <- albums_raw[albums_raw != ""]
```

Seperate album name, artist

```{r}
# Album names are in odd-numbered rows
album_names <- albums_raw[seq(1, length(albums_raw), by = 2)]

# Artist and year are in even-numbered rows
artist_year <- albums_raw[seq(2, length(albums_raw), by = 2)]

# Split artist/year information
split_info <- strsplit(artist_year, " • ")

# Extract artist
artists <- sapply(split_info, function(x) x[2])

# Extract year
years <- sapply(split_info, function(x) x[3])
```

```{r}
albums_df <- data.frame(
  album = album_names,
  artist = artists,
  year = as.numeric(years)
)
```

Save new dataframe as .csv

```{r}
write.csv(albums_df, "Albums_clean.csv", row.names = FALSE)
```
